children: U.S. postal property REIT's Q3 2026 rental income rose 25.2% yr/yr, driven by acquisitions
Adjusted FFO per share grew 9.1% yr/yr in Q3 2026
Company acquired 145 USPS properties for $82 mln in Q3 2026
Company raises 2026 acquisition guidance midpoint by $37.5 mln to $185 mln-$200 mln
Postal Realty Trust increases 2026 AFFO guidance by $0.01 to $1.42-$1.44 per diluted share
Company expects 2026 same store cash NOI growth of 6.0%-7.0%
ACQUISITIONS - Co said rental income growth was driven by acquisitions and internal growth
PROPERTY ADDITIONS - Co added 145 USPS-leased properties at a 6.9% average cap rate, contributing to portfolio expansion
HIGH OCCUPANCY - Portfolio occupancy remained at 99.8% at quarter end
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 6 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the commercial reits peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Postal Realty Trust, Inc. is $25.50, about 17.7% above its November 2 closing price of $21.67
The stock recently traded at 30 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 41 three months ago
